headline: India drugs regulator orders quality checks on cough syrup ingredient
summary: India's drugs regulator has ordered that the source and quality of an ingredient used to make cough syrups be checked and verified as a "top priority", in the wake of the deaths of at least 141 children globally.

headline: Yum Brands' KFC to acquire 218 restaurants from EG Group in UK, Ireland
summary: Yum Brands' KFC on Wednesday said it will acquire 218 restaurants from its largest franchisee EG Group in the UK and Ireland.

headline: Indonesian court papers reveal chain of events that led to cough syrup deaths
summary: Indonesian court documents have revealed for the first time the chain of events that led to toxic ingredients being used in cough syrup that was among the products blamed for the deaths of more than 200 children in the country last year.

headline: ANALYST VIEW Argentine far-right libertarian Milei sweeps to victory
summary: Right-wing libertarian Javier Milei has won Argentina's presidential election, putting an outsider with radical views in charge to fix South America's No. 2 economy battered by triple-digit inflation, a looming recession and rising poverty.

headline: Asda sales growth slows and underperforms UK rivals
summary: Asda, Britain's third largest supermarket group, said on Tuesday its underlying sales rose 2.8% year-on-year in its third quarter - a sharp slowdown from growth of 9.6% in the previous quarter and an underperformance versus its bigger rivals.

headline: UK petrol station group EG to buy Tesla ultra-fast chargers
summary: British petrol station operator EG Group said on Monday it would buy Tesla ultra-fast charging units to boost its electric vehicle charging network across Europe, as the EV maker continues to expand the reach of its charging business.

headline: Sainsbury’s gain is private equity’s pain
summary: Red hot competition in the UK grocery market is favoring the largest players. On Thursday, shares in Britain’s second-largest grocer J Sainsbury’s jumped 5% after it forecast 2024 profit at the upper half of its previous guidance, as customers flocked to its stores.

headline: UK supermarket Asda completes $2.5 bln purchase of EG's UK business
summary: Asda, Britain's third biggest supermarket group, said on Tuesday it has completed the acquisition of the majority of EG Group’s UK & Ireland business for an enterprise value of 2.07 billion pounds ($2.52 billion).
